[[File:Dan Madsen - PR Celebrity.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Dan Madsen in a PR Celebrity promotional image.]]
'''Dan Madsen''' was president of the Official Star Wars Fan Club and the founder and publisher of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'', the fan club's magazine.<ref name="wook-madsen">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Dan_Madsen Dan Madsen], Wookieepedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20251112224917/https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Dan_Madsen Internet Archive], 12 November 2025.</ref> In 1999 his company, Fantastic Media, was home to the official Star Wars and Star Trek fan clubs and their magazines.<ref name="westword-madsen">Chris LaMorte, [https://www.westword.com/news/star-hustlers-5059622 "Star Hustlers"], ''Westword'' (4 March 1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20200811235501/https://www.westword.com/news/star-hustlers-5059622 Internet Archive], 11 August 2020.</ref> He appears uncredited in ''The Phantom Menace'' (1999) as a kaadu handler at the victory parade in Theed.<ref name="wook-damsdenna">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Dams_Denna Dams Denna], Wookieepedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20251209030207/https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Dams_Denna Internet Archive], 9 December 2025.</ref>

== Anagrams ==
[[File:Theed-L-damsdenna.gif|thumb|right|260px|Madsen as the kaadu handler, on [[Dams Denna]].]]
The [[Theed Palace]] card [[Dams Denna]] (2001) shows Madsen in that scene, and its title is an anagram of his name.<ref name="wook-damsdenna" /> Its lore calls Denna a "collector of Linn'con memorabilia"; Madsen collects Abraham Lincoln memorabilia.<ref name="westword-madsen" /> See [[Jokes#Dams Denna|Jokes]].
